info.name: TempGuru Event Staffing API
info.description:
TempGuru's public REST API for W-2 event staffing against a catalog of 345 configured US and Canadian market entries; coverage and lead time require an order-specific check. Includes eight read-only business operations, one health probe, and one opt-in quote-request submission. No authentication required. All rates are all-inclusive W-2 bill rates (worker pay, payroll taxes, workers' comp, general liability, coordinator support).

MCP server: https://mcp.tempguru.co/mcp
OpenAPI 3.1: https://mcp.tempguru.co/openapi.json
Website: https://tempguru.co

variable.description: Replace with the 12-character plan_id returned by plan_staffing. Never guess or enumerate IDs.
TG reference returned by Submit Quote Request. The request's test script updates this automatically after a successful submission.

item.name: Discovery
item.description: List the cities and staffing roles TempGuru covers.

query.description: Filter by 2-letter state code or full name (US + Canadian provinces)

request.description:
Returns all cities TempGuru staffs with tier classification. Optional filters: state (postal code or name), tier (hub/mid/small).

hub = 25 major metros (NYC, LA, Boston, Chicago, SF, etc.)
mid = 128 secondary markets
small = 192 tertiary markets

request.description: The API's only write operation. Replace the test email before sending: this creates a real staffing request in TempGuru's CRM or durable fallback queue for human review. Call only after the user has reviewed and explicitly confirmed the plan. Optional fields include contact_phone, budget_range, attire, special_requirements, compliance_notes, source_platform, skill_id, skill_version, and plan_id. Supply skill_id only when one of TempGuru's canonical skills assembled the request; this manual Postman example intentionally leaves it unset. When plan_id is available, include it to link the saved plan. A successful response updates the collection's quoteReference variable.

Returns the 90-day non-PII receipt status for a TG reference: received or queued. It does not yet expose quote_sent or won. A quote_found:false result does not prove the CRM lead is absent; relay the fixed follow-up guidance. Responses are not cached.
Returns immediately with the service status and deployed version. No caching. Use as a liveness probe or to confirm the running version.
